description: Catalog of Tamil works and artifact collections beyond the Ettuthokai / Pattuppattu reader corpus. `availability` is `reader` when normalized verse JSON exists, `metadata` when only the catalog record is present, and `planned` when there is no data yet. `languages` lists text languages; `translations` lists available translation languages. Adding a work here does not claim it is readable: ingestion is tracked in docs/library/LIBRARY_ROADMAP.md.

collections.description: Post-Sangam gnomic and didactic anthologies on ethics, statecraft, and everyday life. The canonical eighteen works, including the Tirukkural and Naladiyar.
Grammar, classical epics and major works that sit outside the Sangam anthologies but are essential to the Tamil literary canon.

Inscriptions, coins, manuscripts, sculpture, architecture, music and material culture. The full register, legal sources and scholar-reader layers live in data/library/artifacts.json (see docs/library/ARTIFACT_LIBRARY.md).

The five grand epics of Tamil literature (Aimperumkappiyam): Silappathikaram, Manimekalai, Civaka Cintamani, Valayapathi and Kundalakesi. The last two survive only as fragments and quotations in medieval commentaries.
Tamil devotional poetry and hagiography from the Pallava and Chola periods: Saivite Thirumurai, Vaishnava pasurams and the lives of the Nayanar saints.
Classical Tamil grammatical treatises, poetics manuals, and works on akapporul (interior/love poetics).
